medicina.titulo: STAT+: Argenx sees unusual setback with failure of late-stage study of drug for autoimmune disease
medicina.resumo: Argenx said its blockbuster drug Vyvgart didn’t outperform placebo in a Phase 3 trial of patients with Sjögren's disease, a chronic autoimmune disorder.

medicina.titulo: Randomized trial finds targeting individual metastases in oligometastatic breast cancer does not improve survival
medicina.resumo: Treating individual metastatic tumors with highly focused radiation or surgery did not improve progression-free or overall survival for patients with oligometastatic breast cancer receiving first-line systemic therapy, according to results from the randomized NRG-BR002 clinical trial led by researchers at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center.

medicina.titulo: An experimental drug kills fat cells, rather than shrinking them
medicina.resumo: Participants in two small trials lost dangerous fat around their internal organs. This fat is linked to health issues like diabetes and heart problems.

biologia.titulo: Changes in DNA packaging help immune cells swell and burst
biologia.resumo: Immune cells are the elite athletes of the human body. While other cells stay in place, immune cells travel throughout our bodies, squeezing through small channels, stretching themselves, sampling the surfaces of other cells and swallowing up invaders. One of their most extreme behaviors is NETosis, a process in which certain immune cells burst and release their DNA as a way to trap pathogens.

biologia.titulo: Brain cells regulate cholesterol to control neuron signaling
biologia.resumo: Cholesterol, a fat-like substance in the body best known for its role in cardiovascular health, also plays a key role in how neurons—foundational cells for the brain's ability to process and integrate information—communicate with one another. Now, research led by Vitaly A. Klyachko, a professor in the WashU Medicine Department of Cell Biology & Physiology, has shown that brain cells called astrocytes regulate cholesterol supply to modulate neuronal communication. The findings are published in the Journal of Cell Biology.

robotica.titulo: This Disembodied Hand Is All the Robot You Need
robotica.resumo: A hand attached to the end of an arm is a given for most humans, but what if robots didn’t have to play by the same rules as we do? Researchers from ETH Zurich have turned an off-the-shelf robotic hand into a completely self-contained robot that walks on its fingertips while using those same fingers to manipulate its environment. Besides making the perfect Halloween accessory for anyone planning to dress up as a member of The Addams Family – who were famously accompanied by a disembodied walking hand called Thing – the researchers say the approach could make it possible to operate controls and handle objects in places a traditional robot arm can’t reach. Soft Robotics Lab, ETH Zurich/YouTube Amirhossein Kazemipour , a Ph.D. candidate in the Soft Robotics Lab at ETH Zurich in Switzerland who led the project, believes this hand could prove useful in contexts like fiddly maintenance tasks in industrial settings, or in search and rescue, where a robot could detach its hand to explore confined spaces too tight for the rest of its body. More broadly, he says, the work is a step toward a new approach to robotics in which body parts are not confined to a single role. “I wanted to see how m

robotica.titulo: HiPHI: A Large-Scale Benchmark for High-Precision Human Motion and Object Interaction
robotica.resumo: This White Paper gives robotics researchers and engineers an overview of a new large-scale motion capture dataset built to close the data gap limiting humanoid robot learning. It also shows how policies trained on the dataset transfer to a real humanoid robot. What you will learn about: Why humanoid robot learning, a central problem in embodied AI and Physical AI, needs data that internet video and existing motion capture datasets cannot provide. How FrameNet , a linguistic framework for human action, can guide motion capture collection to systematically cover a broad range of whole-body motion. Why synchronized object trajectories and meshes make human-object interaction data useful for teaching robots real-world tasks such as carrying, pushing, and pulling. How reinforcement learning policies trained on this motion capture data improve with scale, and how sim-to-real transfer carries them onto a physical humanoid robot. Download this free whitepaper now!

software.titulo: Microsoft acaba com festa dos PC gamers e nega que GTA 6 rodará via Xbox Cloud Gaming
software.resumo: O chefe de estratégia do XBOX, Matthew Ball, desmentiu uma reportagem do site The Verge que afirmava que o XBOX teria direitos exclusivos de streaming para GTA 6. A informação sugeria que os jogadores de PC poderiam jogar o game da Rockstar pelo XBOX Cloud Gaming , uma forma de contornar a ausência do título nos computadores. Embora a notícia pudesse ser animadora para os jogadores de PC, Ball afirmou em uma publicação no X, nesta terça-feira (6), que esse não é o caso. "Embora seja ótimo ver a empolgação com GTA 6 e o XBOX, isso também levou a algumas informações incorretas", declarou. "Estamos ansiosos para lançar GTA 6 no XBOX em 19 de novembro, embora o jogo não seja transmitido via streaming exclusivamente nem para PC." A informação, no entanto, não deixou claro se o XBOX não contará com streaming no PC ou se GTA 6 estará ausente de qualquer serviço em nuvem , como o NVIDIA GeForce NOW e o Amazon Luna. Ball sugere que os jogadores poderão transmitir o jogo nos consoles XBOX por meio do recurso 'Stream Your Own Game' . hardware.titulo: Preços dos notebooks com NVIDIA RTX Spark assustam e geram revolta
hardware.resumo: Vivemos o pior momento para comprar hardware por conta da atual crise, com escassez de componentes que tem levado os preços à estratosfera. Não é diferente com os notebooks equipados com o novo chip NVIDIA RTX Spark , anunciados hoje, que têm preço inicial de US$ 2.600, mas podem chegar a quase 3x mais , dependendo da configuração e da marca. O SoC da NVIDIA vem com duas configurações diferentes, que alteram a quantidade de núcleos da CPU (18 e 20) e dos núcleos gráficos (5.120 e 6.144 núcleos) . Além disso, dependendo da fabricante, os notebooks podem ter de 24 a 128 GB de memória RAM unificada , além de 512 GB a 2 TB de SSD NVMe . Não bastasse somente essa parte do hardware, existem ainda a qualidade da construção, quantidade de portas, sistema de refrigeração e tipo de painel usado . Tudo isso altera consideravelmente o valor final de um notebook em geral e não seria diferente nesse caso. Vamos dar uma olhada em alguns exemplos. astrofisica.titulo: Solar Orbiter tracks origin of mysterious magnetic switchbacks
astrofisica.resumo: The European Space Agency-led Solar Orbiter spacecraft has flown through an S-shaped kink known as a ‘switchback’ in the solar wind’s magnetic field. By fingerprinting the elusive particles within the switchback, Solar Orbiter has traced its origin back to the Sun’s surface and revealed more about solar magnetism – the unruly instigator of dangerous solar storms.

astrofisica.resumo: Using data from the DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys, with help from artificial intelligence, an international team of scientists has discovered 70 new gravitational lenses—rare cosmic alignments that act as natural magnifying glasses. The new lenses further expand one of the largest collections of confirmed lenses to date and will allow scientists to study dark matter, galaxy evolution and the structure of the universe.

computadores_pessoais.resumo: Microsoft’s new Surface Laptop Ultra is powered by a Mediatek CPU and Nvidia’s powerful RTX Spark SoC, which is mainly designed to run local AI models on the user’s lap. Five competing laptops—from Dell, HP, MSI and more—will offer additional options. Here’s the thinking. Microsoft is banking on near-future AI developers and enthusiasts running local AI models and tools directly from their PC. If needed, they’ll tap Microsoft’s Copilot AI for more horsepower. Microsoft calls this “hybrid intelligence” and it’s basically an acknowledgement that users won’t necessarily care which device does what. It’s a compromise, as is most anything that’s AI-related in productivity: some love it, others despise it. There are further tradeoffs. Users will be able to run models locally, but the Surface Laptop Ultra ships with a 140W power adapter. That’s a signal that it will consume much more power than typical laptops, though not gaming laptops. (That’s another question: is this a gaming laptop? Microsoft showed just a single Gears of War game running on the Ultra, with no indication of frame rate.) But possibly the most exciting thing to land in some time is Nvidia’s Spark RTX, an Arm-based chip that’s now going into consumer laptops, headlined by the Surface Laptop Ultra . “Consumer” gets a bit of an asterisk there. While these Arm-based laptops are at least somewhat similar to Qualcomm-powered Snapdragon models we’ve seen for the last few years, there’s nothing spare or affordable about them. With chips custom-tuned for “AI” at every level, tons of speedy, expensive integrated RAM, and an integrated GPU that matches an RTX 5070 (at least on paper), Nvidia and its partners want these laptops to hit at the high end. They certainly land at high-end prices. RTX Spark laptops start at $2,600 USD, and only get more expensive. Microsoft’s flagship Surface Laptop Ultra is a cool three grand at the recommended configuration. Pre-orders are available now, and shipments should be arriving next week. inteligencia_artificial.titulo: Dell entra na corrida para ensinar agentes de IA a “entender” as empresas
inteligencia_artificial.resumo: A Dell entrou na disputa para resolver um dos problemas que dificultam o uso de agentes de inteligência artificial dentro das empresas: fazer com que esses sistemas entendam o significado dos dados que encontram. A companhia apresentou nesta semana novas tecnologias que conectam informações espalhadas por diferentes sistemas e explicam à IA quais termos, relações e fontes devem ser considerados em cada tarefa. Os principais recursos, porém, só chegam no primeiro semestre de 2027. O movimento coloca a Dell em uma corrida que já envolve empresas como Databricks, Snowflake e Nvidia . O objetivo é criar uma espécie de camada de contexto entre os modelos de IA e os dados corporativos, necessária quando um agente precisa fazer mais do que simplesmente localizar um documento. O problema ganhou importância conforme as empresas começaram a experimentar agentes em tarefas reais. Um levantamento da Modern Data Company com mais de 540 profissionais de 66 países mostrou que 57,3% das organizações já testam ou utilizam agentes de IA , mas apenas 8,4% consideram confiáveis o suficiente os dados que alimentam esses sistemas para uso em produção . inteligencia_artificial.titulo: The U.S. Nuclear Plant Fleet Is Leaning into AI
inteligencia_artificial.resumo: If there is any place that would be off-limits to AI, the control room of a nuclear power plant certainly sounds like one. The nuclear industry is historically cautious and risk averse—understandable given the possible catastrophic consequences of an accident or a mistake. Even well-trained managers struggle with the operational complexity of a nuclear reactor. It’s not the kind of setting that seems well suited to a powerful but error-prone new technology. Reality tells a startlingly different story. A variety of companies have begun to offer AI solutions for nuclear power. This year, nearly the entire fleet of 94 U.S. nuclear reactors has been offered the chance to integrate AI into its operations, and most have taken it. In August, California-based Atomic Canyon launched NIVA , the Nuclear Industry Virtual Assistant, which was developed in cooperation with nuclear industry groups. The assistant was pilot tested in nuclear plants run by Constellation Energy and is now available to the United States’ entire fleet of reactors. energia_materiais.titulo: Platinum in fuel cells lasts longer with nitrogen-enhanced graphene wrapper
energia_materiais.resumo: Researchers from Nagoya University in Japan have developed a durable fuel-cell catalyst by wrapping platinum nanoparticles in nitrogen-containing graphene and placing them on carbon nanotubes. This design retained 96.9% of its active surface after 30,000 durability cycles, pointing towards fuel cells with longer lifespans and lower platinum demand.

energia_materiais.resumo: To mitigate climate change, direct air capture of carbon dioxide (CO₂) from the atmosphere has emerged as an increasingly attractive option for limiting global warming. But scaling up systems to remove and safely store enough CO₂ faces major obstacles, according to researchers at the Georgia Tech School of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering (ChBE).

ciberseguranca.resumo: A Trump Mobile enfrenta um novo problema de segurança após hackers divulgarem dados pessoais ligados a 3.615 pessoas na dark web. O vazamento inclui nomes, endereços residenciais, e-mails, números de telefone e informações sobre pedidos, enquanto os criminosos afirmam que a empresa chegou a dizer que não tinha uma equipe interna preparada para lidar com a invasão . O ataque foi reivindicado pelo grupo de cibercriminosos BYOD. Segundo os hackers, a entrada nos sistemas ocorreu após a infecção do computador de um funcionário da Liberty Mobile com um trojan de acesso remoto, conhecido pela sigla RAT. A empresa da Flórida fornece a infraestrutura de operadora móvel virtual, ou MVNO, usada pela Trump Mobile. Ainda não há uma confirmação independente sobre a maneira exata como a invasão ocorreu. Trump Mobile e Liberty Mobile também não haviam divulgado uma explicação pública sobre o incidente até a publicação das reportagens consultadas. ciberseguranca.titulo: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
ciberseguranca.resumo: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang. KrebsOnSecurity has learned that the suspect, who uses the hacker handle "Rey," was detained as ShinyHunters was in the process of extorting a business unit recently divested by the global aerospace company Boeing, which manufactures the fleet of planes used by the employer of Rey's father -- Royal Jordanian Airlines.

ciberseguranca.titulo: Novo Redmi Turbo da Xiaomi vazou: bateria gigante de 10.000 mAh e chip top
ciberseguranca.resumo: A Redmi está preparando uma nova geração do Turbo 6 , e um vazamento indica que o modelo mais potente da linha pode chegar com bateria de 10.000 mAh e chip Dimensity 9500s . O aparelho deve ser chamado de Redmi Turbo 6 Max e também pode ter uma tela enorme, próxima de 7 polegadas. As informações foram divulgadas pelo conhecido informante Digital Chat Station (DCS). Embora ele não tenha citado diretamente o nome do celular, os detalhes coincidem com rumores anteriores sobre o Turbo 6 Max. 📱 Veja as melhores promoções de hoje no WhatsApp do CT Ofertas Segundo o vazamento, o novo celular terá uma tela grande, com tamanho ainda não confirmado. Rumores anteriores apontam para uma tela OLED plana de aproximadamente 7 polegadas, com resolução 2K. O modelo também pode ter uma estrutura central de metal e leitor de impressões digitais ultrassônico integrado à tela. Bateria de 10.000 mAh é um dos destaques A bateria deve ser outro ponto forte do Redmi Turbo 6 Max. Informações anteriores já indicavam uma capacidade de 10.000 mAh, enquanto o novo vazamento fala em uma bateria que ultrapassa essa marca.
